extra.reason: 59 new unit tests written and passing — all 7 coverage gaps addressed
Per-member per-axis release tracking implemented; writer emits partial EQUATION coupling; 29 new tests

Replaced 0.5m proximity search with endpoint-targeting: uses domain model geometry to find member endpoint closest to connection position, then matches mesh node within 10mm. Falls back to 0.5m for members without geometry.
Exact-overlap members now share a combined physical group ('A||B'). Writer parses pipe-separated names and assigns elements to all named members. Partial-overlap fallback preserved.
Fixed by elements_data forwarding fix (xld): _write_validated_loads_within_step now receives elements_data so U1 DLOAD→CLOAD conversion runs. All 4 portal_01 tests pass.

Already fixed by commit 539c49c (shell expansion node registration in _register_node_memberships). Verified: tests/integration/test_results_json.py::TestSlab01ResultsJson::test_member_envelope_present passes.

Fixed in unified_calculix_writer.py with two changes:
1. _identify_and_retype_u1_members() now strips elements retyped to U1 from
   every non-U1 member's element_sets entry once retyping is complete, so a
   native (RECT/CIRC/etc.) member sharing mesh elements with an overlapping
   U1 (I/T/L/C-section) member no longer references those elements in its own
   *BEAM SECTION ELSET.
2. _write_sections()'s dedup guard for overlapping-geometry members now
   subtracts already-claimed elements from a member's set and writes a
   section for whatever remains, instead of skipping the member's entire
   section on any overlap. This fixes the case where a member sharing only a
   few elements with an earlier-processed member (e.g. the building_01a
   "hub" member sharing elements with 5 other members) was losing ALL of its
   elements, not just the shared ones.

Added regression tests in test_overlapping_member_fallback.py:
- TestU1RetypeStripsSharedElements (2 tests) — exercises the retyping fix
  directly.
- TestSectionDeduplication::test_partial_overlap_writes_remaining_elements —
  exercises the partial-overlap write fix.

Verified against the real building_01a/portal_01 example models:
- portal_01: all 4 previously-failing integration tests now pass.
- building_01a: the original *BEAM SECTION "not a beam element" errors are
  gone; CalculiX now proceeds past input-deck reading into STEP execution.
  It hits a DIFFERENT, unrelated, pre-existing bug there (filed separately as
  eez — CalculiX 'gen3delem: first thickness ... is zero').

Full non-slow suite: 729 passed, 1 pre-existing unrelated failure (ziq,
buckling benchmark). No regressions.

Fixed in unified_calculix_writer.py and boundary_condition_handling.py:

1. Replaced the ad-hoc overlap dedup logic that had accumulated in
   _write_sections() (from the earlier 51j fix) with a single centralized
   method, _resolve_overlapping_element_sets(), called once in the pipeline
   right after _identify_and_retype_u1_members(). It mutates self.element_sets
   in place so every downstream consumer (raw *ELSET cards, orientation
   grouping, nodal thickness, node-membership registration, section writing)
   sees a consistent, non-overlapping assignment. _write_sections() itself is
   back to its pre-51j simplicity — it just reads the already-resolved sets.

2. Fixed two DLOAD-writing checks in boundary_condition_handling.py
   (lines ~1170, ~1270) that tested `element_set_name not in element_sets`
   (key presence) instead of `not element_sets.get(element_set_name)`
   (non-emptiness). A member losing all its elements to overlap resolution
   still has a (now-empty) dict entry, so the old check let a *DLOAD card
   through referencing an *ELSET that _write_element_sets() never actually
   writes (it skips empty lists) — CalculiX rejected the file with
   "ERROR reading *DLOAD: element set".

Rewrote the unit tests from 51j (TestSectionDeduplication) to target
_resolve_overlapping_element_sets() directly instead of _write_sections(),
plus a new no-overlap sanity test. Fixed a real regression this surfaced:
the interim per-write-site fix used elset names like MEMBER_M1_SHELL, which
broke tests/integration/test_element_member_mapping.py's naive
"MEMBER_" prefix matching (treated the raw and filtered elsets as two
different members' sets, flagging false overlap duplicates) — the
centralized fix no longer introduces any new elset names, so this is moot.

Full suite: 730 passed, 1 pre-existing unrelated failure (ziq). Slow suite:
7 failures, all the same still-open eez bug (unrelated gen3delem issue,
confirmed unchanged by these fixes — verified the exact error signature is
identical before and after).

Root cause confirmed as a CalculiX 2.23 gen3delem.f bug (missing 'U'-prefix exclusion for USER ELEMENT types); fixed via source patch (patches/calculix-gen3delem-user-element.patch, verified by rebuilding CCX) plus a code-side clear-error detection in CalculixRunner
